content: bwmarrin/snowflake Go library: classic 41/10/12 layout, int64, custom epoch default 1288834974657 (Twitter, Nov 04 2010). Sequence overflow within one millisecond blocks until the next ms. README stresses each node must have a unique node number even across servers or uniqueness is not guaranteed. Node creation via NewNode(nodeID); custom Epoch/NodeBits/StepBits must be set before any package call. Single-goroutine generator internally synchronized (~244ns/op).
